resources.string:
Recite from memory: the words are hidden and appear as you recite them correctly. If you make a mistake or stop, the next word is given to you.

Everything happens on this device. Your voice is not recorded unless you turn on recording in Settings; recordings stay on this device and are never backed up or sent.

Automatic feedback can be wrong and does not replace a qualified teacher.
Following your recitation needs a speech model (%1$d MB), downloaded once. After that, memorization works fully offline.\n\nModel: %2$s, %3$s.
The model could not be downloaded: %1$s
Memorize needs the microphone to follow your recitation.
When you make a mistake or stop, the next word is given to you in the reciter\'s voice, one word at a time until you continue
A wrong word is marked (not shown); if you don\'t correct it, the right word is given
Give the next word when you stay silent
Also treat wrong short vowels as mistakes (more false alarms)
For using the prayer corrector during salah: let the app keep listening in the background
The phone may stop listening to save battery.
Not downloaded yet; it is downloaded the first time you memorize
%1$s, %2$s.\n\nDelete it to free space? It will be downloaded again the next time you memorize.
The recitation model (%1$d MB) is downloaded the first time you memorize. To set it up without internet, copy %2$s and %3$s (or the .zip they came in) to this phone and import them, one at a time.
These files are not the recitation model

Your recitation is processed only on this device. Nothing is recorded unless you turn on recording or Record and contribute, and recordings never leave the device unless you export them. Progress keeps each session\'s counts on this device (Settings > Progress).

To speak the hints offline, %1$s\'s recitation is needed. Download this sura, or the whole Quran so that you are never stopped? Without it, hints are only shown. Automatic downloads can be turned on in Settings.
Place the phone close in front of you, at the edge of your prayer mat. It hears you best within about one meter.
Memorization could not start. If this keeps happening, delete the recitation model in Settings and download it again.
Or choose the .zip with both files
That isn\'t the right file. Choose %1$s.
That .zip doesn\'t contain the model\'s files.
You can listen to yourself afterwards. The recording stays on this device.
Replace the older recording of the same place
Exported, with its alignment (alignment.json) and a training manifest (manifest.jsonl)
The recording could not be exported
Download the recitation model and the hint voice when they are needed, without asking (may use mobile data)
The recitation model and the hint voice for the whole Quran, in one go
A Wi-Fi connection is recommended. The downloads go on in the background.
A larger model listens again before a hint or a mistake mark, so fewer are wrong (%1$s download).
Recommended for this phone: a check takes about %1$s s here.
Not recommended for this phone: it has %1$s of memory, and the check needs about 300 MB more while you recite.
Not recommended for this phone: its processor is too old for it.
Not recommended for this phone: a check takes about %1$s s here, so hints would come late.
%1$s\n\nIts model (%2$s) is downloaded once and works offline: %3$s, %4$s.
Delete the double-check model (%1$s) too? It can be downloaded again.
Also download the double-check (%1$s), recommended for this phone: fewer wrong hints and mistake marks
Double-check model, recommended for this phone: %1$s
When you read with the text shown, a wrong or skipped word is marked on the page
When you read with the text shown, the correct word is said in the hint voice after a mistake
From memory. The page is hidden, and the words appear as you recite them.
Reading. The page stays as it is, and the words are marked as you read.
Hands-free with the screen off. Reminds you if you get stuck.
Recorded, as set in Record my recitation
More ways to recite, including salah
Keeps every session on this phone with what the speech model heard, to help improve it. Nothing is sent.

Every Memorization, Recitation and salah session will be recorded on this phone, with what the speech model heard and how the app followed you. These recordings can help improve the speech model and the app.

Nothing is sent. The recordings stay on this phone until you delete them, and a later version will ask you before sharing anything.

You can listen to them, export or delete them in Recording sessions.
Listen to your sessions on their pages, export or delete them
Turn on Record and contribute, or Record my recitation, in Settings. Then tap the microphone on a page and choose Memorization or Recitation. Each session you record appears here.
Let a word or two pass (marked as skipped)
Choose a session to play it back on its pages.
The session over time: where words were given, skipped or marked. Tap to play from there.
